name: Reagents for Reclaimers Inc.
summary: In Desolace, Kreldig Ungor sends you to Ironforge with Leftwitch's package. Roetten Stonehammer has your pay, and Kreldig plans to speak well of you when he returns home.

sections.title: Payment in Ironforge
sections.body: Kreldig says Roetten Stonehammer has your pay in Ironforge. Roetten will be glad to receive Leftwitch's package, and handing it over should be enough to collect what you are owed. Kreldig expects to stay in Desolace only a little longer. Once he is home, he still means to speak well of you.

sections.title: Roetten's Thanks
sections.body: Roetten Stonehammer welcomes Leftwitch's package from Desolace and thanks you for your work and for doing it quickly. Your payment is ready. Roetten says Reclaimers Inc. always pays well for a hard week's work.

faq.q: Who sends you back to Ironforge?
faq.answer: After the reagents are gathered, Kreldig Ungor sends you to Ironforge with Leftwitch's package.

faq.q: Where does Leftwitch's package need to go?
aliases: where do i take the package
faq.answer: Leftwitch's package goes to Roetten Stonehammer in Ironforge.

faq.q: Why do you carry the package to Roetten?
faq.answer: Kreldig says Roetten Stonehammer has your pay, so you carry him the package in Ironforge.

faq.q: Is Kreldig Ungor remaining in Desolace?
faq.answer: Kreldig expects to leave Desolace soon. Once he is home, he still plans to speak well of you.
